show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/F3gzE3
show.description:
If a person knew exactly when death would come, how would they feel?
What happened to Uday, who gained the power to know when others would die?
How did he get that power? What did he do with it?
Watch “Death Countdown” on your Kuku TV
